name: Universe of Thoughts (UoT)
description: Universe of Thoughts (UoT) is an evaluation benchmark designed to assess creative reasoning capabilities of large language models across three paradigms: combinational, exploratory, and transformative reasoning. It measures creativity through feasibility, utility, and novelty metrics on tasks requiring innovative problem-solving.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest to researchers studying creativity and reasoning in LLMs.
notes: Introduces a computational framework for creative reasoning and novel tasks to evaluate creativity in LLMs.
